use_cases.title: Monitor portfolio performance
use_cases.description: An investment professional reviews the portfolio overview, compares portfolio performance against the benchmark, switches among defined time ranges, inspects hovered data points in a custom tooltip, and locks or clears a selected chart point while keeping summary-card values anchored to the dashboard summary rather than transient hover state.
use_cases.summary: Review portfolio performance over selectable periods
use_cases.value: Provides a fast view of portfolio value, return, and benchmark-relative performance across supported periods.

cites.quote: Changing the value must update:
Portfolio Performance
Tooltip appears on hover.
Clicking a chart point locks the selection.

criteria.text: Time range options are 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL.
The default time range is 1M.
Exactly one time-range value is active, and changing it updates the performance chart data range, visible x-axis labels, and displayed period comparison.
The performance chart includes portfolio and benchmark lines, horizontal grid, axes, a custom tooltip, an active point indicator, and portfolio area fill; it must not use a default library tooltip.

cite.quote: The chart must not rely on a default browser/graph-library tooltip.

criteria.text: Hovering updates the date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return, but must not modify summary-card data.
Clicking a chart point locks selection, a second click unlocks it, Escape clears the lock, and changing time range clears the selected point.

cite.quote: Changing time range clears the selected point.

use_cases.title: Customize dashboard layout and chart display
use_cases.description: An investment professional opens the customization drawer to change display density, show or hide major dashboard sections, and turn chart options on or off, with the expectation that the visible layout, benchmark line, grid, and hover indicators actually update and reflow in place.
use_cases.summary: Adjust dashboard density, sections, and chart options
use_cases.value: Lets the user tailor information density and visible workspace content without leaving the page.

cites.quote: A right-side drawer opens.
These controls must actually affect the interface.
Disabling a section removes the section and surrounding layout must reflow.
Disabling Grid removes chart grid.

criteria.text: Display density options are Compact, Comfortable, and Spacious, with Comfortable selected by default.
Visible-section toggles cover Portfolio Summary, Performance, Allocation, Holdings, Risk, Market Overview, Alerts, and Activity.

cite.quote:
☑ Portfolio Summary
☑ Performance
☑ Allocation
☑ Holdings
☑ Risk
☑ Market Overview
☑ Alerts
☑ Activity

criteria.text: Chart options are Benchmark, Grid, and Hover Indicators.

cite.quote: Disabling a section removes the section and surrounding layout must reflow.

criteria.text: Disabling Benchmark removes the benchmark line and related legend element, disabling Grid removes the chart grid, and disabling Hover Indicators removes active hover marker behavior.

cite.quote: Disabling Hover Indicators removes the active hover marker behavior.

use_cases.title: Navigate dashboard contexts
use_cases.description: An investment professional moves among the dashboard’s portfolio, analytics, research, and system contexts through the fixed sidebar, changes the active state and page heading without routing to another page or URL, and stays within the single-page terminal while contextual content updates in place.
use_cases.summary: Switch dashboard context within the single-page workspace
use_cases.value: Keeps navigation fast and contained while exposing all major dashboard areas from one shell.

cite.quote: The entire experience must be a **single page**.

cites.quote: The entire experience must be a **single page**.
Sidebar items may alter active navigation state or contextual content, but the application remains within the same page.
Clicking an item changes active state and contextual page heading.

criteria.text: Navigation stays within one page: there is no application routing, separate dashboard pages, URL navigation, or multi-page workflow.

cite.quote:
* no application routing
* no separate dashboard pages
* no navigation to another URL
* no multi-page workflow

criteria.text: Primary navigation items are Overview, Portfolio, Markets, Watchlist, and Transactions.
Analytics items are Performance, Risk, Attribution, and Scenarios.
Research items are Research Notes, Saved Views, and Reports.
System items are Alerts and Data Health.
Overview is selected by default, and clicking a sidebar item changes active state and contextual page heading without routing away.

cite.quote: Sidebar navigation does not route away.
